scripts.build: (cd apps/ecommerce && vite build) && (cd apps/assistant/client && vite build)
scripts.type-check:all: (cd apps/ecommerce && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.test.json) && (cd apps/assistant/client && tsc --noEmit)
scripts.lint: (cd apps/ecommerce && eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts) && (cd apps/assistant/client && eslint src)
scripts.lint:fix: (cd apps/ecommerce && eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts --fix) && (cd apps/assistant/client && eslint src --fix)
scripts.lint:all: (cd apps/ecommerce && eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts tests/vitest/**/*.ts) && (cd apps/assistant/client && eslint src)
scripts.lint:all:fix: (cd apps/ecommerce && eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts tests/vitest/**/*.ts --fix) && (cd apps/assistant/client && eslint src --fix)
scripts.lint:report: (cd apps/ecommerce && eslint assets/ts/**/*.ts tests/vitest/**/*.ts --format json --output-file var/tools/eslint/report.json || true) && (cd apps/assistant/client && eslint src --format json --output-file reports/eslint.report.json || true)
